description.zh: 商品code，如ecsRi、scu_bag等。如果填写该字段，则prodCode字段不生效
description.en: The code of the resource, such as ecsRi and scu_bag. If this parameter is specified, the ProdCode parameter does not take effect for the request.

description.zh: 被抵扣实例的ID，为空时返回所有实例的明细数据。
description.en: The ID of the deducted instance. If this parameter is not specified, the details of all instances are returned.
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

description.zh:
是否包含财务云子账号的资源包用量
- true：包含
- false：不包含
description.en:
Specifies whether to query the resource plan usage of linked accounts. Valid values:

*   true: queries the resource plan usage of linked accounts.
*   false: does not query the resource plan usage of linked accounts.

description.zh: 筛选查询的实例ID，为空时返回所有的使用的实例明细。
description.en: The ID of the instance to query. If this parameter is not specified, the details of all used instances are returned.
The instance type of the instance.

description.zh: 查询从LastToken之后开始返回。第一次查询填null，之后的从结果NextToken获取
description.en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. For the first query, set the value to null. For subsequent queries, set the value to the token that is obtained from the NextToken parameter.

description.zh: 每次查询条数，默认为20，最大值为300。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.
The code of the service. Example: ecs.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.
